cobblemon.species.slowbro.desc: Slowbro's tail has a Disturban firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
cobblemon.species.slowbro-galar.desc: A Disturban bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.slowking.desc: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Disturban on its head comes off.
cobblemon.species.slowking-galar.desc: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Disturban intelligence to the point that Disturban now controls Slowking.
